description: This file contains a collection of API client functions for a web-based dashboard. It interfaces with various endpoints related to user management, organization, models, teams, and activity metrics. It also includes utility functions for configuration, error handling, and data formatting within a React/TypeScript project.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

methods.name: getCallbackConfigsCall
methods.description: Fetches callback configuration metadata from the server asynchronously.

methods.name: setGlobalLitellmHeaderName
methods.description: Sets the global header name used for authorization/authentication.

methods.name: makeModelGroupPublic
methods.description: Makes specified model groups public.

methods.name: getUiConfig
methods.description: Retrieves UI configuration including proxy URL and server path, updating internal settings accordingly.

methods.name: getPublicModelHubInfo
methods.description: Fetches public information about the model hub.

methods.name: getOpenAPISchema
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenAPI schema.json for API documentation.

methods.name: modelCostMap
methods.description: Fetches a map of model costs asynchronously.

methods.name: reloadModelCostMap
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the model cost map on the server.

methods.name: scheduleModelCostMapReload
methods.description: Schedules a future reload of the model cost map.

methods.name: cancelModelCostMapReload
methods.description: Cancels any scheduled model cost map reload.

methods.name: getModelCostMapReloadStatus
methods.description: Fetches status of the model cost map reload.

methods.name: modelCreateCall

methods.name: modelSettingsCall

methods.name: modelDeleteCall
methods.description: Deletes a model by ID.

methods.name: budgetDeleteCall
methods.description: Deletes a budget entry by ID.

methods.name: budgetCreateCall
methods.description: Creates a new budget with given form data.

methods.name: budgetUpdateCall
methods.description: Updates an existing budget with new form data.

methods.name: invitationCreateCall
methods.description: Creates a new user invitation.

methods.name: invitationClaimCall

methods.name: alertingSettingsCall
methods.description: Fetches current alerting configuration/settings.

methods.name: keyCreateServiceAccountCall
methods.description: Generates a new service account key with preprocessed form data.

methods.name: keyCreateCall
methods.description: Creates a new API key, with success notifications.

methods.name: userCreateCall
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified form data.

methods.name: keyDeleteCall
methods.description: Deletes an API key by key string.

methods.name: userDeleteCall
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple users.

methods.name: teamDeleteCall

methods.name: v2TeamListCall

methods.name: teamListCall
methods.description: Fetches all teams with optional filters.

methods.name: availableTeamListCall

methods.name: organizationListCall
methods.description: Retrieves list of organizations.

methods.name: organizationInfoCall
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about a specific organization.

methods.name: organizationCreateCall
methods.description: Creates a new organization with form data.

methods.name: organizationUpdateCall
methods.description: Updates an existing organization.

methods.name: organizationDeleteCall
methods.description: Deletes an organization by ID.

methods.name: transformRequestCall
methods.description: Performs a request transformation via server API.

methods.description: Fetches daily activity data for users.

methods.description: Gets daily activity for tags.

methods.name: teamDailyActivityCall

methods.name: organizationDailyActivityCall

methods.name: customerDailyActivityCall

methods.name: agentDailyActivityCall
methods.description: Fetches daily activity data for agents.

methods.name: modelInfoV1Call
